title: Public Health Personnel
description: Requirements Applicants should possess: A minimum of a Bachelor's Degree in Public Health, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or any related discipline. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Strong interpersonal and relationship-building abilities. Good organizational and time management skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail, and Forms). Basic computer and data entry skills. Ability to use Microsoft PowerPoint or Canva for presentations and educational materials. Knowledge of social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X) for health awareness campaigns. Experience in a healthcare organization, NGO, marketing, public health campaign, or community outreach will be an added advantage. Responsibilities: Representing RightLiving Health Foundation professionally while maintaining high ethical standards. Identifying and securing suitable venues for Health Sensitization Programmes using the Foundation's official proposal letters. Planning and executing community health awareness campaigns. Organizing and facilitating health education seminars, wellness talks, and fitness programmes. Building relationships with organizations, schools, churches, companies, and community groups. Conducting market research to identify opportunities for expanding the Foundation's health programmes. Delivering engaging presentations on preventive healthcare and the Foundation's services. Supporting the implementation of health maintenance programmes and organizational policies. Creating simple health education materials and promotional content. Assisting with data collection, reporting, and administrative duties when required. NB: Passionate about health promotion and community development. Confident public speakers. Self-motivated and willing to meet set targets. Professional, honest, and teachable. Ready to learn and grow within the organization. Applicants must reside within Effurun, PTI, Enerhen, Jakpa, Uvwie, or other nearby areas in Warri, Delta State.

title: Nutritionist

Conduct workplace wellness seminars and health education sessions. Assist in organizing community health outreaches and medical screenings. Interpret health screening results related to nutrition. title: Nutritionist
description: Responsibilities: Assess clients’ nutritional status, dietary habits, and health goals. Develop personalized meal plans based on clients’ nutritional needs. Provide one-on-one and group nutrition counseling sessions. Educate clients on healthy eating habits and lifestyle modifications. Monitor clients’ progress and adjust nutrition plans where necessary. Conduct nutrition screenings and dietary assessments. Promote disease prevention and overall wellness through proper nutrition. Provide evidence-based nutrition advice and recommendations. Support clients in managing nutrition-related health conditions. Maintain accurate and confidential client records. Prepare nutrition reports and documentation when required. Collaborate with doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals. Organize and participate in health promotion campaigns and community outreach programs. Develop educational materials on nutrition and healthy living. Ensure compliance with professional ethics, safety, and organizational policies. Stay updated on current nutrition guidelines and best practices. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Nutrition, Dietetics, Food and Nutrition, or a related field. Strong knowledge of nutrition principles and healthy eating practices. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Good interpersonal and counseling skills. Ability to educate and motivate clients toward healthier lifestyle choices. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good organizational and time-management skills. High level of professionalism and ethical conduct. Attention to detail and accuracy in record keeping. Ability to maintain client confidentiality at all times. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint). Basic computer literacy and willingness to learn electronic health record systems. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary healthcare team. Strong customer service and client relationship management skills. Willingness to participate in continuous professional development and training. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple responsibilities. Positive attitude, integrity, and a commitment to improving community health and wellness.

title: Community Health Worker
description: Responsibilities: Conduct community outreach programs to promote health awareness and preventive healthcare practices. Educate individuals, families, and community groups on hygiene, nutrition, maternal and child health, immunization, family planning, and healthy lifestyle practices. Identify community health needs and provide appropriate health education, guidance, and referrals. Organize and participate in medical outreaches, health campaigns, wellness screenings, and vaccination programs. Perform basic health assessments, including blood pressure, blood glucose, temperature, weight, and other routine health checks where applicable. Support clients in accessing healthcare services by coordinating referrals and follow-up care. Conduct home visits to monitor clients' health status and reinforce health education where necessary. Maintain accurate records of patient interactions, outreach activities, referrals, and community health reports. Collaborate with healthcare professionals and other stakeholders to ensure continuity and quality of care. Encourage adherence to prescribed treatments and promote positive health behaviors. Identify and promptly report disease outbreaks, public health concerns, and emergencies to the appropriate authorities. Participate in health education seminars, training sessions, and continuous professional development activities. Ensure confidentiality and privacy of patient and community information at all times. Comply with organizational policies, infection prevention protocols, and health and safety regulations. Perform other related duties as assigned by management. Requirements Minimum of an OND in Community Health, Public Health, Nursing, Health Education, Environmental Health, or a related field. Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in community health, primary healthcare, public health, or wellness programs. Valid professional certification or license (where applicable) is an added advantage. Sound knowledge of health education, disease prevention, and community engagement strategies. Good understanding of primary healthcare principles and public health practices. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and counselling skills. Strong organizational, documentation, and reporting skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office applications is an added advantage. Ability to communicate effectively in English and local languages is an added advantage. Remuneration: NGN 80,000 per month
